message.content:
Here’s a classic list of ingredients you’ll need to make a traditional baked lasagna (serves about 8–10 people): | Category | Typical Ingredients | |----------|---------------------| | **Pasta** | • 12–15 sheets of lasagna noodles (regular or no‑boil) | | **Meat Sauce** | • 1 lb (≈ 450 g) ground beef
• ½ lb (≈ 225 g) ground pork (optional, for richer flavor)
• 1 small onion, finely chopped
• 2–3 cloves garlic, minced
• 1 can (28 oz / 800 g) crushed tomatoes or whole‑tomato sauce
• 1 can (15 oz / 425 g) tomato paste (optional, for thicker sauce)
• 1 cup beef or vegetable broth (optional, to adjust consistency)
• 1 tsp dried oregano
• 1 tsp dried basil
• ½ tsp dried thyme
• Salt & pepper to taste | | **Ricotta Layer** | • 15 oz (≈ 425 g) ricotta cheese
• 1 egg (helps bind)
• ¼ cup grated Parmesan cheese
• Pinch of nutmeg (optional)
• Salt & pepper to taste | | **Mozzarella Layer** | • 3–4 cups shredded mozzarella (or a mix of mozzarella & provolone) | | **Parmesan Crust** | • ½–¾ cup grated Parmesan cheese | | **Optional Extras** | • Fresh basil or parsley for garnish
• Red pepper flakes for heat
• Spinach or other vegetables (e.g., mushrooms, zucchini) sautéed and added to the meat sauce or layered separately | ### Quick Prep Tips 1. **Cook the noodles** according to package instructions (if using regular pasta). Drain and set aside on a lightly oiled sheet to prevent sticking. 2. **Brown the meats** with onions and garlic, then add tomatoes, herbs, and broth. Simmer for 20–30 min to meld flavors. 3. **Mix ricotta** with egg, Parmesan, salt, pepper, and nutmeg. 4. **Layer**: Start with a thin layer of sauce, then noodles, ricotta mixture, mozzarella, sauce, repeat until all layers are used, finishing with a generous topping of mozzarella and Parmesan. 5. **Bake** at 375 °F (190 °C) for 45–55 min, or until bubbling and golden. Let rest 10–15 min before serving. Enjoy your homemade lasagna!
